title: Structure-Aware Numerical Stabilization for Half-Precision Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.13306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local online training on resource-constrained platforms requires low computational and training-state overhead. We study the numerical stability and computational efficiency of half-precision proximal policy optimization (PPO) on commodity GPUs. Directly converting PPO training to FP16 is unreliable because numerical errors feed back through policy updates and subsequent data collection, while PPO repeatedly compares a current policy with a fixed behavior policy. We propose PPO-FP16 with three structure-aware modules. Global scalar protection stabilizes statistics shared across a minibatch or parameter update. Policy-change residual protection extracts and preserves small differences between the current and behavior policies. Efficient persistent-update protection stabilizes optimizer state and parameter writeback while reducing state storage. These changes preserve the PPO objective, hyperparameters, and training budget. translated_title: 面向半精度近端策略优化的结构感知数值稳定化方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13306v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：在资源受限平台上的本地在线训练需要较低的计算开销和训练状态开销。我们研究了半精度近端策略优化（PPO）在商用GPU上的数值稳定性与计算效率。直接将PPO训练转换为FP16是不可靠的，因为数值误差会通过策略更新和后续的数据收集不断反馈累积，而PPO需要反复将当前策略与固定的行为策略进行比较。我们提出了包含三个结构感知模块的PPO-FP16方法：全局标量保护用于稳定在小批量数据或参数更新之间共享的统计量；策略变化残差保护用于提取并保留当前策略与行为策略之间的微小差异；高效持久更新保护用于稳定优化器状态和参数回写，同时减少状态存储。这些改动完整保留了PPO的目标函数、超参数和训练预算。在六个连续……
tldr: 提出PPO-FP16方法，通过全局标量保护、策略变化残差保护和高效持久更新保护三个结构感知模块，解决了FP16直接训练PPO时数值误差反馈累积的问题，在保持原有目标函数和训练设置的同时实现了稳定高效的半精度训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes PPO-FP16, which achieves reliable and efficient half-precision PPO training on commodity GPUs through three structure-aware modules—global scalar protection, policy-change residual protection, and efficient persistent-update protection—while preserving the original objective, hyperparameters, and training budget.
